thesis: Hold. Sizing equity is about $999, cash about $750 (roughly 75%), and the only position is VTI at about $249 (about 25% of equity), already above this tier's 15% single-name guide, so I will not add. Items before the 17:00Z cutoff do not justify a new broad ETF or a sale of the existing one: the S&P 500 is described as within 2 percentage points of its record close while many stocks are in a bear market, junk bonds are heading for their worst month since 2022, job openings are low and hiring is weak, and a bond-market interview flags inflation and government debt alongside the AI boom. The 10-year is 5.281% (up 4.1 bp) with TLT at 77.93 (down 0.88%), so I will not add duration. VIX at 16.33 (up 1.62%) is a mild lift, not a stress print that justifies selling VTI. WTI at 90.41 (down 2.37%) and USO at 145.77 (down 2.83%) are context; the United States oil, gas, and commodity-fund 8-Ks are Regulation FD filings without figures I can underwrite. Netflix and the other single-name items are outside this mandate. Cash stays well above the 40% floor. Proposal only; no fill assumed.
